meta.figures: Each OpenET field's monthly crop ET (OpenET ensemble) and rain (gridMET), in millimetres, exactly as OpenET's field list sent them.
meta.outlines: Each field's outline is OpenET's, exactly as its field list sent it (GeoJSON, longitude and latitude to 6 decimals). Each field's acres, and its acres inside each use area, were measured from these outlines in California Albers (EPSG 3310) after repair.
